issues.reason: The distributing Implication the reviewer demands would assert that each individual cancer kills thousands of people every year — false content — while the flat unmarked event plus (Every e 1 year) is exactly the habitual shape *Frequency & habitual schedules* licenses ('The market opens every Monday'), so this is graceful improvisation in the gap the reviewer itself documents, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: No licensed form fits an aggregate statistical kind-level claim: the kind-relation route needs bare kind NPs on both sides (blocked by the counted object 'thousands of people'), and the distributing rule would falsely hand the yearly aggregate to every instance.
new_gaps: A bare kind/mass symbol as the AGENT filler of a habitual event is unaddressed — the instruction set licenses the bare class symbol only for non-specific/generic OBJECTS ('pays tax', 'cooked dinner').
notes: Roles (kill destroys -> Patient; inanimate transitive subject -> Agent), the vague-count CardinalityPhrase on a GroupOf, and the tenseless habitual with (Every e 1 year) all follow the instruction set as written.
